en.title: Famous quotes in English — 22 public-domain lines

es.title: Citas célebres en español — 22 líneas de dominio público
es.blurb: Veintidós líneas de autores de dominio público, con atribución en cada tarjeta.
es.authorNote: Solo dominio público estricto. Si una atribución no se puede verificar, se descarta.

items.text: El viaje de mil millas comienza con un solo paso.
items.translation: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

items.text: La única sabiduría verdadera está en saber que no sabes nada.
items.translation: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.

items.text: La vida es lo que hacen de ella nuestros pensamientos.
items.translation: Our life is what our thoughts make it.

items.text: El que lee mucho y anda mucho, ve mucho y sabe mucho.
items.translation: He who reads much and walks much, sees much and knows much.

items.text: Sé tú mismo; los demás ya están ocupados.
items.translation: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

items.text: No importa lo despacio que vayas mientras no te detengas.
items.translation: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

items.text: La belleza está en los ojos del que mira.
items.translation: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

items.text: La experiencia es la madre de la ciencia.
items.translation: Experience is the mother of knowledge.

items.text: No hay mal que cien años dure.
items.translation: No evil lasts a hundred years.

items.text: La libertad, Sancho, es uno de los más preciosos dones.
items.translation: Liberty, Sancho, is one of the most precious gifts.

items.text: Caminante, no hay camino, se hace camino al andar.
items.translation: Walker, there is no road — the road is made by walking.

meta.author: Antonio Machado
meta.era: principios del siglo XX, dominio público en LatAm pre-1928

items.text: Nada es permanente, salvo el cambio.
items.translation: Nothing is permanent except change.

items.text: El que tiene un porqué para vivir, puede soportar casi cualquier cómo.
items.translation: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

items.text: La ignorancia afirma o niega rotundamente; la ciencia duda.
items.translation: Ignorance affirms or denies vehemently; science doubts.

items.text: El que no se arriesga, no cruza el mar.
items.translation: He who doesn't take risks doesn't cross the sea.

items.text: Todo lo que necesitas es un plan, un mapa de ruta y el coraje de empujar hacia tu destino.
items.translation: All you need is a plan, a roadmap and the courage to press on toward your destination.

items.text: En medio de la dificultad reside la oportunidad.
items.translation: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.

items.text: Una habitación sin libros es como un cuerpo sin alma.
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.text: Si quieres ser feliz, selo.
items.translation: If you want to be happy, be.

items.text: Vivir no es sólo existir, sino existir y crear.
items.translation: To live is not just to exist, but to exist and create.

items.text: Más vale maña que fuerza.
items.translation: Skill is worth more than strength.

items.text: La vida es realmente simple, pero insistimos en complicarla.
items.translation: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.

fr.title: Citations célèbres en français — 22 lignes libres de droits
fr.blurb: Vingt-deux lignes de penseurs et écrivains du domaine public, avec attribution sur chaque carte.
fr.authorNote: Strictement domaine public. Si une attribution ne peut être vérifiée, on l'écarte.

items.text: Je pense, donc je suis.
items.translation: I think, therefore I am.

items.text: L'homme est né libre, et partout il est dans les fers.
items.translation: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.

items.text: On ne voit bien qu'avec le cœur.
items.translation: One sees clearly only with the heart.

items.text: Ce qui ne me tue pas me rend plus fort.
items.translation: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger.

items.text: Le voyage de mille lieues commence par un pas.
items.translation: A journey of a thousand leagues begins with a step.

items.text: La vie, c'est ce que nos pensées en font.
items.translation: Our life is what our thoughts make it.

items.text: Il n'y a de vraie sagesse que de savoir qu'on ne sait rien.
items.translation: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.

items.text: La seule victoire contre l'amour, c'est la fuite.
items.translation: The only victory against love is flight.

items.text: Rien n'est permanent sauf le changement.
items.translation: Nothing is permanent except change.

items.text: L'habit ne fait pas le moine, mais l'ignorance fait l'esclave.
items.translation: Clothes don't make the monk — but ignorance makes the slave.

items.text: Tout ce que je sais, c'est que je ne sais rien.
items.translation: All I know is that I know nothing.

items.text: L'enfer, c'est les autres… non, l'enfer, c'est soi-même parfois.
items.translation: Hell is other people… no, sometimes hell is oneself.

items.text: Vivre, c'est penser.
items.translation: To live is to think.

items.text: Celui qui a un pourquoi peut supporter n'importe quel comment.
items.translation: He who has a why can bear almost any how.

items.text: Qui veut la fin veut les moyens.
items.translation: He who wants the end wants the means.

items.text: Au milieu de la difficulté se trouve l'opportunité.
items.translation: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.

items.text: Il ne faut jamais remettre au lendemain ce que l'on peut faire le jour même.
items.translation: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.

items.text: La beauté est dans les yeux de celui qui regarde.
items.translation: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

items.text: Soyez vous-même ; les autres sont déjà pris.
items.translation: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

items.text: L'expérience est le maître de toutes choses.
items.translation: Experience is the teacher of all things.

items.text: Une pièce sans livres est comme un corps sans âme.
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.text: Tout ce que tu peux faire, ou rêves de pouvoir faire, commence-le.
items.translation: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it.

de.title: Berühmte Zitate auf Deutsch — 22 gemeinfreie Zeilen

items.text: Was mich nicht umbringt, macht mich stärker.
items.translation: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger.

items.text: Wer ein Warum zum Leben hat, erträgt fast jedes Wie.
items.translation: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

items.text: Es ist nichts beständig als die Veränderung.

items.text: Alles, was du tun oder träumen kannst, das beginne.
items.translation: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it.

items.text: Ich denke, also bin ich.

items.text: Die Reise von tausend Meilen beginnt mit einem einzigen Schritt.
items.translation: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

items.text: Ich weiß, dass ich nichts weiß.

items.text: Das Leben ist, was unsere Gedanken daraus machen.

items.text: Sei du selbst, alle anderen sind schon vergeben.

items.text: Erfahrung ist der Lehrer aller Dinge.
items.translation: Experience is the teacher of all things.

items.text: Ein Raum ohne Bücher ist wie ein Körper ohne Seele.
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.translation: If you want to be happy, be.

items.text: Das Leben ist eigentlich einfach, aber wir bestehen darauf, es kompliziert zu machen.

items.text: Alles Schöne ist zugleich schwer.

items.text: Freundschaft verdoppelt die Freuden und halbiert die Sorgen.

items.text: Es ist nicht genug zu wissen — man muss auch anwenden.
items.translation: Knowing is not enough — we must apply.

zh.title: 中文名言 — 22 条公有领域
zh.blurb: 公有领域的作家与思想家留下的中文名言 22 条,每张卡都有出处。
zh.authorNote: 严格限定公有领域(作者 1950 年前去世,中国以作者去世 50 年后为准)。来源无法确认的直接剔除。

items.text: 学而时习之,不亦说乎?
items.translation: To learn and practise regularly — isn't it delightful?

items.text: 己所不欲,勿施于人。
items.translation: Don't do to others what you wouldn't want done to you.

items.text: 知之为知之,不知为不知,是知也。
items.translation: To know what you know and know what you don't — that is knowledge.

items.text: 千里之行,始于足下。
items.translation: A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step.

items.text: 天将降大任于斯人也,必先苦其心志。
items.translation: When heaven sends a great task to someone, it first torments their mind.

items.text: 士不可以不弘毅,任重而道远。
items.translation: A scholar must be strong and resolute — the burden is heavy and the road long.

items.text: 我思故我在。
items.translation: I think, therefore I am.

items.text: 三人行,必有我师焉。
items.translation: Among any three people, there is sure to be a teacher for me.

items.text: 海内存知己,天涯若比邻。
items.translation: A friend in the four seas feels close as a neighbour, even at the ends of the earth.

meta.author: 王勃《送杜少府之任蜀州》

items.text: 吾生也有涯,而知也无涯。
items.translation: My life has an end, but knowledge has none.

items.text: 祸兮福之所倚,福兮祸之所伏。
items.translation: Disaster is where fortune leans; fortune is where disaster hides.

items.text: 读书破万卷,下笔如有神。
items.translation: Read ten thousand books, and your writing will feel inspired.

meta.author: 杜甫《奉赠韦左丞丈二十二韵》

items.text: 有志者,事竟成。
items.translation: Where there's a will, there's a way.

items.text: 少壮不努力,老大徒伤悲。
items.translation: If you don't work hard when young, you'll grieve in vain when old.

items.text: 山高月小,水落石出。
items.translation: The mountain is tall and the moon small; water recedes and the stones appear.

items.text: 欲穷千里目,更上一层楼。
items.translation: To see a thousand miles, climb one more floor.

items.text: 君子坦荡荡,小人长戚戚。
items.translation: The gentleman is open and calm; the small man is always troubled.

items.text: 塞翁失马,焉知非福。
items.translation: The old man of the frontier lost his horse — who knows if it's not a blessing?

items.text: 吾日三省吾身。
items.translation: I examine myself three times a day.

items.text: 虚心使人进步,骄傲使人落后。
items.translation: Humility leads to progress; pride leads to regression.

items.text: 一日之计在于晨。
items.translation: The plan of the day lies in the morning.

items.text: 不以物喜,不以己悲。
items.translation: Not pleased by things, not saddened by self.

hi.title: हिंदी के मशहूर उद्धरण — 22 पब्लिक-डोमेन पंक्तियां
hi.blurb: पब्लिक डोमेन के मनीषियों और लेखकों की हिंदी में 22 पंक्तियां, हर कार्ड पर स्रोत।
hi.authorNote: केवल सत्यापित पब्लिक डोमेन। अप्रमाणित हो तो हटा दिया।

items.text: मैं सोचता हूँ, इसलिए मैं हूँ।
items.translation: I think, therefore I am.

items.text: मैं यही जानता हूँ कि मैं कुछ नहीं जानता।
items.translation: I know only that I know nothing.

items.text: हज़ार मील की यात्रा एक क़दम से शुरू होती है।
items.translation: A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step.

items.text: हमारी ज़िंदगी हमारे विचारों से बनती है।
items.translation: Our life is what our thoughts make it.

items.text: कर्म किए जा, फल की चिंता मत कर।
items.translation: Do your duty, don't worry about the fruit.

items.text: जो हुआ, अच्छा हुआ। जो हो रहा है, अच्छा हो रहा है। जो होगा, अच्छा होगा।
items.translation: Whatever has happened, happened well; whatever is, is well; whatever will be, will be well.

items.text: सत्यमेव जयते।
items.translation: Truth alone triumphs.

items.text: अहिंसा परमो धर्म:।
items.translation: Non-violence is the highest virtue.

items.text: जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह।
items.translation: Where there's a will, there's a way.

items.text: ज्ञान बाँटने से बढ़ता है।
items.translation: Knowledge grows by sharing.

items.text: क्षमा बड़न को चाहिए, छोटन को उत्पात।
items.translation: Forgiveness befits the great; mischief befits the small.

items.text: रहिमन धागा प्रेम का, मत तोड़ो चटकाय।
items.translation: O Rahim, don't snap the thread of love.

items.text: बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय।
items.translation: I went looking for evil — none did I find.

items.text: कल करे सो आज कर, आज करे सो अब।
items.translation: What you'll do tomorrow, do today; what you'll do today, do now.

items.text: अनुभव हर चीज़ का गुरु है।
items.translation: Experience is the teacher of all things.

items.text: किताबों के बिना कमरा आत्मा के बिना शरीर जैसा है।
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.text: जिसके पास 'क्यों' है, वह किसी भी 'कैसे' को झेल सकता है।
items.translation: He who has a why can bear almost any how.

items.text: ख़ुश रहना चाहते हो, तो हो जाओ।
items.translation: If you want to be happy, be.

items.text: मुश्किल के बीच में ही मौका छिपा होता है।
items.translation: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.

items.text: जीवन सचमुच सरल है, पर हम उसे पेचीदा बना देते हैं।
items.translation: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.

items.text: ख़ुद बनो, बाकी सब पहले से भरे हुए हैं।
items.translation: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

items.text: कुछ भी असंभव नहीं है, अगर मन पक्का हो।
items.translation: Nothing is impossible if the heart is firm.

tr.title: Türkçe ünlü sözler — 22 kamu malı
tr.blurb: Kamu malı yazar ve düşünürlerin Türkçe sözlerinden 22 tanesi. Her kartta kaynak var.
tr.authorNote: Yalnızca doğrulanmış kamu malı. Kaynağı belirsizler çıkarıldı.

items.text: Düşünüyorum, öyleyse varım.
items.translation: I think, therefore I am.

items.text: Hiçbir şey bilmediğimi biliyorum.
items.translation: I know only that I know nothing.

items.text: Bin millik yolculuk tek bir adımla başlar.
items.translation: A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step.

items.text: Hayatımız düşüncelerimizin yarattığı şeydir.
items.translation: Our life is what our thoughts make it.

items.text: Beni öldürmeyen şey beni güçlendirir.
items.translation: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger.

items.text: Yavaş yürümen önemli değil, yeter ki durma.
items.translation: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

items.text: Hiçbir şey kalıcı değildir, değişimden başka.
items.translation: Nothing is permanent except change.

items.text: Yaşamak için bir 'neden'i olan hemen her 'nasıl'a dayanabilir.
items.translation: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

items.text: Kendin ol — başkaları çoktan alındı.
items.translation: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

items.text: Her şeyin öğretmeni deneyimdir.
items.translation: Experience is the teacher of all things.

items.text: Kitapsız bir oda, ruhsuz bir beden gibidir.
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.text: Gelenek, geçmişi bugünün içine taşıyan köprüdür.
items.translation: Tradition is the bridge that carries the past into the present.

items.text: Severim ben seni, candan içeri.
items.translation: I love you from within the soul.

items.text: Vatan sevgisi imandandır.
items.translation: Love of homeland is part of faith.

items.text: Gel, gel, ne olursan ol yine gel.
items.translation: Come, come — whoever you are, come again.

items.text: Dilin kemiği yoktur.
items.translation: The tongue has no bone.

items.text: Mutlu olmak istiyorsan, mutlu ol.
items.translation: If you want to be happy, be.

items.text: Güçlüklerin ortasında fırsat yatar.
items.translation: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.

items.text: Hayat aslında basittir, biz onu karmaşık hale getiririz.
items.translation: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.

items.text: Yapabildiğin ya da yapabileceğini düşlediğin her şeye başla.
items.translation: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it.

items.text: Çok bilen çok yanılır.
items.translation: He who knows much, errs much.

items.text: Nerede birlik, orada dirlik vardır.
items.translation: Where there is unity, there is harmony.

ar.title: اقتباسات شهيرة بالعربية — 22 سطراً من الأعمال الحرة
ar.blurb: اثنان وعشرون سطراً لمفكرين وكتّاب في الملكية العامة، مع إسناد على كل بطاقة.
ar.authorNote: فقط الملكية العامة الموثّقة. ما لا نستطيع التحقق منه نحذفه.

items.text: أنا أفكر إذاً أنا موجود.
items.translation: I think, therefore I am.

items.text: كل ما أعرفه هو أنني لا أعرف شيئاً.
items.translation: I know only that I know nothing.

items.text: رحلة الألف ميل تبدأ بخطوة.
items.translation: A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step.

items.text: حياتنا هي ما تصنعه أفكارنا.
items.translation: Our life is what our thoughts make it.

items.text: ما لا يقتلني يجعلني أقوى.
items.translation: What doesn't kill me makes me stronger.

items.text: لا يهم مدى بطء مسيرك، ما دمت لا تتوقف.
items.translation: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

items.text: لا شيء يدوم إلا التغيير.
items.translation: Nothing is permanent except change.

items.text: من كان لديه 'لماذا' يعيش من أجلها، يستطيع احتمال أي 'كيف'.
items.translation: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

items.text: التجربة معلم كل الأشياء.
items.translation: Experience is the teacher of all things.

items.text: غرفة من غير كتب كجسد من غير روح.
items.translation: A room without books is like a body without a soul.

items.text: كن نفسك؛ كل الأشخاص الآخرين مأخوذون أصلاً.
items.translation: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

items.text: إذا الشعب يوماً أراد الحياة، فلا بد أن يستجيب القدر.
items.translation: If a people one day desires life, destiny must answer.

items.text: على قدر أهل العزم تأتي العزائم.
items.translation: Resolutions come to the measure of resolute men.

items.text: وما نيل المطالب بالتمني، ولكن تؤخذ الدنيا غلابا.
items.translation: Desires are not met by wishing; the world is seized by effort.

items.text: العلم في الصغر كالنقش على الحجر.
items.translation: Learning in youth is like engraving on stone.

items.text: رب أخ لك لم تلده أمك.
items.translation: Many a brother to you was not born of your mother.

items.text: اعمل لدنياك كأنك تعيش أبداً، واعمل لآخرتك كأنك تموت غداً.
items.translation: Work for this life as if you'll live forever; work for the next as if you die tomorrow.

items.text: إذا كنت ذا رأي فكن ذا عزيمة.
items.translation: If you have an opinion, have the resolve to match.

items.text: في وسط الصعوبة تكمن الفرصة.
items.translation: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.

items.text: الحياة بسيطة في الحقيقة، لكننا نصر على تعقيدها.
items.translation: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.

items.text: إذا أردت أن تكون سعيداً، فكن.
items.translation: If you want to be happy, be.

items.text: من جد وجد، ومن زرع حصد.
items.translation: He who strives finds; he who sows reaps.
